title: Separate SBI stablecoin reserve assets, payment-network scale, consortium membership and production maturity

decisions.rule: JPYSC issuance, short-term JGB allocation and lending applications are separate. Do not treat lending applications as loans or reserve assets as XRP collateral.
JPYSC remains account-only until official external transfer activation and validated public-chain transactions. A future Open Standard or BlackRock MOU does not override current route status.
Record SBI's USD50M Startale investment, SMBC's 5% SBI Startale Marketing stake and SBI's separate Circle JV/equity as distinct capital relationships.
PhotonPay's USD65B annualized TPV is all-rail volume; do not infer stablecoin-only or XRP volume when asset/rail composition is undisclosed.
Shared Open Standard membership with Coinbase/Mastercard is a network relationship, not proof of direct bilateral integration or XRP settlement.
SBI/Startale/BlackRock tokenized-MMF/JPYSC work remains an MOU until fund identity, network, production issuance and settlement transactions are evidenced.

feature_admission: NONE. JPYSC JGB reserves, PhotonPay total TPV, Open Standard membership, SMBC equity participation and BlackRock MOU remain context features. No XRP price predictor feature is admitted.
